summary: Phase 1A Stop-Point-2 backend + frontend E2E gate PASSES. 19/19 unit tests + 28/28 new HTTP integration tests + frontend visual verification all green. SHA-256 chain, marker JSON, thumbnail PNG, integrity endpoint, 6-stage upload progression, deterministic no-LLM detection, seed shape (28 markers = 17 automatic + 9 manual + 2 system_generated + 0 calculated), CRUD + hide/unhide + soft delete, publish/archive lifecycle, legacy retirement, auth 401/403 — every review item verified.
critical_code_review_comments: contract_templates_routes.py is ~680 lines and packs list/detail/upload/status/rename/publish/archive/duplicate/set-default/source-pdf/integrity/thumbnail/marker-summary into a single attach() function. Still readable but nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the R2 helper and the thumbnail renderer into small modules in Phase 1B.

The upload endpoint uses asyncio.create_task without a task registry. On graceful shutdown mid-upload the job would be left in 'running' state. Not blocking for Phase 1A (single-node dev), but recommend a Mongo-side sweep for jobs older than N minutes still 'running' in Phase 1B.

PATCH /admin/contract-templates recomputes marker_summary only when template_required_codes changes. If HQ mutates contract_type via the same PATCH, the summary's not_eligible_for_type is stale until next GET /marker-summary (which does recompute). Consider always recomputing on any PATCH that touches contract_type or template_required_codes.

Marker Library GET currently returns hidden=false OR missing hidden field. Fine for now but adds an implicit invariant — recommend backfilling all seed docs with explicit hidden=false at seed time (already the case for new seeds).
Positive: contract_markers_pipeline.py and contract_templates_routes.py contain zero references to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, litellm, anthropic, openai — LLM-free guarantee holds.
